title: Haqdar mujahid
body:
haq daar mujahid ay abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
saqqa e haram mashkeeza liye jald aaiye darya se
pani ke liye bechain yahan bacche hai khade pyase
aa dekhle pyasa hai mujahid ay abbas
haq daar mujahid ay abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
haibat se teri bhaage hai layeen abbas darya se
aada se taraayi cheen liye do roz ke pyase
aa dekhle tareekh hai shahid ay abbas
haq daar mujahid ay abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
parde ke muhafiz aa bhi jaa ye kaisi neend aayi
bewon ki ridayein lene ko hai fauje yazeed aayi
aa koi nahi behosh hai abid ay abbas
haq daar mujahid ay abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay sher e dilawar aa bhi jaa zainab ki himayat ko
hai raat bhayanak nikli hai qaimon ki hifazat ko
aa dekhle islam ki qayad ay abbas
haq daar mujahid ay abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
farzande nabi hota hai zibha abbas sajde mein
tanha hai shahe deen koi nahi juz yaas sajde mein
aa aakhri sajde mein hai saajid ay abbas
haq daar mujahid ay abbas...
